text.text_excerpt: I slept with Elvis!!! Ok, MAYBE I just slept in the same room he did when he stayed at this hotel in '58 while he was in town filming "King Creole". Whatever...Technicalities. Still kind of an awesome thing for this gal who grew up dancing with her daddy to his music. This hotel is absolutely beautiful, elegant and opulent. It feels like a quaint B&B with its intimacy and charm. It's everything I think of when I think vintage New Orleans. It was such a refreshing treat... Each suite is decorated differently, all with exceptional attention to detail. We absolutely LOVED high ceilings, the cherry wood, hand carved four corner post bed, the textured, embroidered wall paper, the gold crown mo...

I love a fancy house that has been converted into a hotel! There is just something so cozy about a place like that and when you step into the Cornstalk you feel as if you are stepping into a castle in a far away land. We occupied a room downstairs and it was small, but gorgeous. The room was complete with gorgeous wall paper, an antique style phone and old books. The decor of the entire hotel is just lovely and has a beautiful antique feel. We were bouncing around the entire hotel taking pictures and exploring, and the staff was really nice and accommodating. My only complaint is that there was some kind of construction being done right outside the window of our room and it was a little l...

My boyfriend and I loved the romantic little hotel! It was so cute and a truly unique experience. There are about 10 rooms and two stories with amazing balcony and front patio views. In fact, if you sit outside for more than 15 minutes you will see how many guided tours stop by and mention the history of the place. The staff was very accommodating, and made every necessity other hotels offer available to us plus some. They even bake cookies nightly around 7pm for guests, which I thought was so cute!
